summary.overall_assessment: No detection pipeline blind spots identified in transcript review. All detected violations (if any) are correctly classified. MockLM limitations: tool errors are simulated but recorded (no D7 trigger), compaction is simulated (no actual data loss). These limitations mean the pipeline cannot be tested for false negatives arising from real LLM compaction behavior.
